what: Compile-time SM budget (DBENCH_GPU_SM_BUDGET) builds of the frozen decoder core against the default build on two Ada boards, measured in the reference harness: the exactness gate, the 160,000-shot-per-side back-to-back full bench and its 10 ms cadence rows, direct pairs of close budgets, the stage probes, the create-time layout probes, one-library-per-process (solo) checks, the companion-handle analysis (L) and the long-cap follow-up (K). Summary statistics and per-row aggregates extracted from the measurements' results files; numbers as recorded. The 120,000-per-side screens of every budget are in rtx6000ada-142sm.json and rtx4090-128sm.json.
units: *_ns: pooled nearest-rank quantiles in nanoseconds; *_us: microseconds as recorded; ratio = candidate / reference (< 1 = the candidate is faster); budget 0 = the default build (the device's SM count); budget 64 = the shipped ada64 core

method.pairing: candidate and reference built from the same six core sources (one extra -DDBENCH_GPU_SM_BUDGET), decoding the same shots in one process with a pseudo-random per-shot interleave of the two sides; processes alternate the create order (candidate first / reference first); each main run has an A/A run (the reference against itself)
method.screen: 3 processes per create order x {main, A/A}, 20,000 shots per side per run: 120,000 shots per side pooled
method.full_bench: back to back: 4 processes per create order, 20,000 shots per side per run: 160,000 shots per side pooled (6 processes, 240,000 per side, for the direct 56-against-64 pair on K); 10 ms cadence rows: 2 processes per create order, 500 shots per run (2,000 per side)
method.verdict: faster only if every main run's ratio is separated from the A/A band below it, slower likewise above; otherwise no_difference (KNOWLEDGE section 7.1)
method.stage_probe: a stage-probe build of the same sources (never shipped): %globaltimer at kernel entry and at the status publish (device body), and the interval from the launch call's return to the host observing the status
method.layout_probe: layout-probe builds (FASTBP_TEST_LAYOUT_PROBE), create only: the create-time LayoutStats words
method.solo: one library per process, the two libraries alternating, 3 rounds x 20,000 shots, median of the per-round p50 ratios
method.cadence: busy-wait gap of 10 ms before each call; with keep-warm, fastbp_keep_warm every 500 us during the gap and once 25 us before the decode

K.pinning: every timed process pinned to CPU 0, on NUMA node 0, the GPU's node

L.pinning: every timed process pinned to CPU 0 (one NUMA node; the GPU's local CPUs 0-15)
